title: [C#] Inherited scene tries to access the base scene references which are disposed
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducable in 4.6, 4.5 (both Mono) ### System information Godot v4.6.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9571) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900KF (32 threads) - 31.81 GiB memory ### Issue description **Short Version:** When having scenes which inherit from a base scene, in specific cases the inherited scene tries to access already disposed objects from the base scene instead of the objects from inherited scene. **Long Version:** Imagine you have the following Setup. - Entity.cs (your base class) - EntityTree.cs (inherits from Entity.cs) - Hitbox.cs (is an export property in Entity.cs) The scenes are also build up like this. **Entity.tscn** **EntityTree.tscn** (inherits from Entity.tscn) **The Problem:** The Hitbox.cs Script has a property which refers to the Entity as "Target" so GetParent() does not need to be called. Feels cleaner. The Problem is when you assign the Target in the Base scene and want to access the Target via code, it is already disposed because it seems it tries to access the Entity.cs, not EntityTree.cs even when explicitly instantiating the EntityTree.cs. In the Inspector it does not show the Base object assigned. It shows the EntityTree assigned. So I would assume it also tries to reference the EntityTree and not the already disposed base object. As soon as I access the Target property in the Hitbox the following error appears ### Steps to reproduce 1. Make a base class and a class which inherits from it 2. Make a base scene with the base class assigned and an inherited scene which gets the inherited class assigned 3. Make a child node which has a script and a property which exports the base class and assign the base scene 4. Run the code ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [DisposedObjectAccess.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26654252/DisposedObjectAccess.zip)
